title: yosoi::session::Work
docs:
Exclusive authority to operate one retained tab, keeping its Session owner alive.

Work serializes operations on that tab. Each operation separately acquires
bounded worker capacity; yielding a wait retains tab control while releasing
that execution permit. Releasing Work does not close the Session or tab.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::assert_all
members.signature: pub async fn assert_all(&self, assertion: &yosoi::assertions::LocalAssertion) -> Result<yosoi::automation_record::OperationReceipt, yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs:
Captures once, validates one Contract record, and checks it immediately.
Captures one current Contract observation and evaluates its local predicate group.
Returns a receipt with retained assertion evidence; failed checks are
not retried. Invalid or unbound assertions and unavailable authority or
evidence return [`SessionError`]. All ordinary predicates are evaluated,
including those after a false predicate.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::assert_condition
members.signature: pub async fn assert_condition(&self, condition: &yosoi::flow::Condition) -> Result<yosoi::automation_record::OperationReceipt, yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs:
Checks a DOM condition once against current-tab evidence without waiting or retrying.
Returns an observed or rejected assertion receipt. Invalid input,
denied assertions, and unavailable authority return [`SessionError`].

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::click
members.signature: pub async fn click(&self, selector: &str) -> Result<yosoi::automation_record::OperationReceipt, yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs:
Dispatches a click to one selector-resolved target on the owned tab.
Returns an effect receipt, including known rejection or uncertainty;
permission, input, and pre-dispatch failures return [`SessionError`].
Confirm the expected page state separately rather than blindly retrying unknown effects.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::enter_text
members.signature: pub async fn enter_text(&self, selector: &str, text: &str) -> Result<yosoi::automation_record::OperationReceipt, yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs:
Types `text` into one selector-resolved editable target on the owned tab.
The target is checked again before keyboard dispatch. Returns an effect
receipt rather than a claim that application state accepted the text;
authority, permission, input, and pre-dispatch failures return [`SessionError`].

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::evaluate
members.signature: pub async fn evaluate(&self, source: &str) -> Result<yosoi::automation_record::OperationReceipt, yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs:
Executes explicitly permitted JavaScript in the current main frame and world.
Returns a bounded effect receipt. Post-dispatch errors or oversized
results can leave effects unknown; permission, input, and authority
failures return [`SessionError`]. Confirm business effects separately.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::evaluate_file
members.signature: pub async fn evaluate_file(&self, snapshot: &yosoi::action::JavaScriptSourceSnapshot) -> Result<yosoi::automation_record::OperationReceipt, yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs:
Executes retained construction-time file bytes on the current main frame and world.
No live file read occurs here. Returns a bounded receipt or [`SessionError`]
for invalid snapshots, permissions, authority, or dispatch uncertainty.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::evaluate_file_targeted
members.signature: pub async fn evaluate_file_targeted(&self, target: &yosoi::session::JsTarget, snapshot: &yosoi::action::JavaScriptSourceSnapshot) -> Result<yosoi::automation_record::OperationReceipt, yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs:
Executes a validated file snapshot in one uniquely selected current frame.
Changed disk contents do not replace captured bytes. Only the main world
is supported. Returns a bounded receipt or [`SessionError`]; possible
dispatch must not be interpreted as proof of no effect.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::evaluate_module
members.signature: pub async fn evaluate_module(&self, bundle: &yosoi::action::JavaScriptModuleBundle) -> Result<yosoi::automation_record::OperationReceipt, yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs:
Executes a retained local module bundle on the current main frame and world.
Uses captured bytes instead of rereading files and requires arbitrary-script
permission. Returns a bounded receipt or [`SessionError`], retaining
post-dispatch uncertainty instead of silently retrying.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::evaluate_module_targeted
members.signature: pub async fn evaluate_module_targeted(&self, target: &yosoi::session::JsTarget, bundle: &yosoi::action::JavaScriptModuleBundle) -> Result<yosoi::automation_record::OperationReceipt, yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs:
Executes a retained local module graph in one uniquely selected current frame.
Checks bundle structure, input bounds, permission, and any epoch
precondition before dispatch. Isolated worlds are currently unsupported.
Returns a bounded effect receipt or [`SessionError`]; no effect rollback is implied.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::evaluate_targeted
members.signature: pub async fn evaluate_targeted(&self, target: &yosoi::session::JsTarget, source: &str) -> Result<yosoi::automation_record::OperationReceipt, yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs:
Executes source after uniquely resolving the frame and checking any epoch precondition.
Only the main world is currently supported. Explicit arbitrary-script
permission is required. Returns a bounded receipt or [`SessionError`],
preserving possible post-dispatch uncertainty rather than retrying it.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::navigate
members.signature: pub async fn navigate(&self, url: &str) -> Result<yosoi::automation_record::OperationReceipt, yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs:
Navigates the owned tab after validating `url` and checking action permission.
Returns a receipt recording observed, rejected, or unknown effects.
Authority, input, or pre-dispatch admission failures return [`SessionError`];
an observed command is not by itself a business-success assertion.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::observe
members.docs:
Captures owned current-tab DOM evidence within the configured observation bound.
Returns [`SessionError`] if authority, DOM permission, evidence, or
execution capacity is unavailable. This observes the current epoch; it
does not prove that a preceding business action succeeded.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::release
members.signature: pub async fn release(self) -> Result<(), yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs:
Consumes Work and drops its exclusive control guard without closing the tab or Session.
The current implementation returns `Ok(())` immediately; it does not
await browser cleanup or resolve uncertain prior effects. Close the tab
or owning Session explicitly when cleanup confirmation is required.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::screenshot
members.docs:
Captures the current tab screenshot and returns its bounded operation receipt.
Permission and authority failures return [`SessionError`]. A retained
screenshot is visual evidence, not an assertion of business completion.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::until
members.signature: pub async fn until(&self, trigger: Option<&yosoi::flow::Step>, expectation: &yosoi::expect::Expectation) -> Result<yosoi::automation_record::OperationReceipt, yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs: Installs observation before an optional trigger, then parks until confirmed.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::wait
members.signature: pub async fn wait(&self, milliseconds: u64) -> Result<yosoi::automation_record::OperationReceipt, yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs:
Waits an explicit millisecond duration, including zero, without confirming a condition.
Returns a receipt on completion; cancellation, operation-deadline, denied
action, and authority failures return [`SessionError`]. Prefer bounded
event-driven confirmation when readiness, rather than elapsed time, matters.

members.title: yosoi::session::Work::wait_until
members.signature: pub async fn wait_until(&self, condition: &yosoi::flow::Condition, timeout_ms: u64) -> Result<yosoi::automation_record::OperationReceipt, yosoi::session::SessionError>
members.docs:
Confirms a DOM condition within a positive millisecond deadline using browser events.
When configured, the wait retains exclusive tab authority while yielding
worker capacity. Returns a confirmation receipt, including rejection or
unavailable evidence; invalid input and authority failures return [`SessionError`].
